summary: Verified web-side Help/SOS + customerOnly OTP guard end-to-end. Partner phone on checkout OTP shows inline 'Account already exists' and stays on step 1; customer logs in normally. Booking AZO557577 (status=started) renders help-sos-card-AZO557577 with help-btn + sos-btn (<a href='tel:112'> with window.confirm). Booking AZO6BC0AE (assigned) correctly hides the card. BookingDetailsDrawer shows drawer-help-btn and drawer-sos-btn (also tel:112). Clicking Help opens help-sos-modal, creates ticket TKT-100003 ('Help · Booking AZO557577'), customer can send messages via help-sos-input/help-sos-send. Admin (+919000000000) /admin → Support Tickets shows the ticket; thread displays the customer messages and admin reply persists & is retrievable by customer via GET /api/support/tickets/{id}. SSE subscribe('support_message') + 4s polling fallback already wired in HelpSOS, so cross-side realtime update path is in place. Expo app (Customer/) could not be previewed per instructions and was skipped.
critical_code_review_comments: HelpSOS.jsx subscribe('support_message') handler relies on d.ticket_id – ensure backend SSE emits that key; current 4s polling fallback masks any mismatch, so verify SSE payload shape to avoid the fallback becoming the only transport.

In OtpLogin.verify(), on customerOnly reject the OTP is cleared and step reset to 1, but the newly-returned JWT is simply discarded (never passed to login). That is correct for the current requirement, but note the server already issued the token — consider calling /auth/logout or marking the token unused if session accounting is tracked server-side.
